summary: Wang arXiv:2603.07280v11 (last revised 2026-08-29) still states R_F2(<3,3,3>) >= 20 as the headline result.  The exact rank is placed in [20,23].  No public rank-22 decomposition or rank-21 lower-bound proof was found in the checked record.
note: The raw wang_latest_recheck.json has conservative regex flags (frontier_recheck_result=needs_verification, false abstract flags, spurious near-21 flag).  This resolution is based on direct reading of the saved v11 abstract HTML and PDF text, which state 'the bilinear complexity of multiplying two 3x3 matrices over F_2 is at least 20' and place the exact rank in [20,23].  The Theorem 1 statement is R_F2(<3,3,3>) >= 20.  No 'at least 21' statement was found in the PDF text.
